method.artifact: Bounded integration recommendation/code sketch, not a built application.
method.runner_context: Task plus preloaded SKILL.md and task-named available references; same task across variants; gates hidden.
method.isolation: Fresh CLI context, auto-discovery/customizations disabled, no tools/network/account writes. Codex tool events checked; host skill discovery disabled using an under-development feature flag.
method.grading: Separate clean context, shuffled A/B/C answers, variant labels hidden; same model family grades each cohort. Gate status passed/failed/unverified with evidence.
method.holdout_switch: Claude session quota interrupted the original holdout attempt. All original holdout cases were rerun across all variants using a separate Codex cohort; cohort totals are not pooled in the headline bars.
method.review: Author reviewed the execution-ownership ambiguity, policy-parser sketch, targeted misses, and selected grader evidence. No independent human or production certification. The core score covers the frozen outcome gates only; selected core answers also made speculative claims beyond those gates (such as inferring an unreviewed period from the newest changelog entry date). The headline score is not a factual-accuracy score for every sentence.
method.cost: Reported Claude list-price estimates cover the retained runner calls in each cohort, not an invoice or full development/grading cost. Codex monetary cost is unavailable. Input tokens include cache-read/creation tokens where reported; wall time is per call.
method.reuse: Unchanged core baseline/no-skill answers and unaffected candidate answers were reused in the second round. Affected candidate cases were rerun; targeted policy baselines were rerun on Codex to match that cohort.
